question.text: As per the SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 1992, Regulation 18A, a Compliance Officer must immediately and independently report to SEBI any:

answer.text: Change in the broker's registered office address
Quarterly financial results of the broker

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 18A(2) of the SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 1992 requires the Compliance Officer to immediately and independently report to SEBI any non-compliance observed by him. The Trap: Address changes, sub-broker appointments, and quarterly financial results are not what Regulation 18A(2) targets; the rule is specifically about non-compliance reporting. Note: The words "immediately and independently" emphasise that the Compliance Officer should not wait for management approval to report violations to SEBI.
